maintenance_led.reason: Sells specialty ingredients (cellulose derivatives, PVP polymers, excipients) for customers' new product formulations, not repair or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private pharma, personal care, coatings, food and agricultural companies paid by commercial and consumer markets.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows through R&D, technology platforms and plant expansions (Ireland, Brazil), not a steady stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Excipients and additives are qualified into customers' formulations, especially pharma, so switching means re-qualification and regulatory approval.
